title: Spike: alternative container runtimes for the VM harness (future scope)
objective: Evaluate whether a runtime other than Docker (rootless Podman, containerd/nerdctl, systemd-nspawn, etc.) would better serve the VM-based harness. This is future scope and does not block epic #35; no implementation is done here.

acceptance_criteria.text: Docker, rootless Podman, containerd/nerdctl and at least one OS-level alternative are compared on compose compatibility, rootless support, Docker API/socket compatibility, GPU support, image tooling and Arch/CachyOS packaging.
Migration cost from the current compose.yaml and ./lab model is stated, including what would break (compose semantics, socket API, volumes and networking).
A go/no-go recommendation with prerequisites and an explicit risk list is recorded in a decision log.
No code changes are made under this ticket; it stays out of epic #35's completion criteria.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Future scope, deliberately outside epic #35. The owner likes Docker as the mechanism inside the VM for now; this ticket exists so alternatives are evaluated deliberately rather than by accident.
